rows.create_graph_type_statement:
CREATE GRAPH TYPE IF NOT EXISTS `onto_verify_5602e6b6cefa_lending_type` AS {
  NODE TYPE `Borrower` (LABEL `Borrower`{`borrower_id` STRING NOT NULL, `party_type` STRING NOT NULL, `identity_evidence` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`borrower_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Lender` (LABEL `Lender`{`lender_id` STRING NOT NULL, `institution_scope` STRING NOT NULL, `name` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`lender_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Loan` (LABEL `Loan`{`loan_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_system` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `principal_amount` DECIMAL(18, 2) NOT NULL, `currency` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `status` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`loan_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `LoanApplication` (LABEL `LoanApplication`{`application_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_system` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `event_time` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `status` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`application_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `CreditFacility` (LABEL `CreditFacility`{`facility_id` STRING NOT NULL, `limit_amount` DECIMAL(18, 2) NOT NULL, `currency` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`facility_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Disbursement` (LABEL `Disbursement`{`disbursement_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_system` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `event_time` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `amount` DECIMAL(18, 2) NOT NULL, `currency` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`disbursement_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Repayment` (LABEL `Repayment`{`repayment_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_system` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `event_time` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `amount` DECIMAL(18, 2) NOT NULL, `currency` STRING NOT NULL, `status` STRING NOT NULL, `reverses_id` STRING DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`repayment_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `CreditInquiry` (LABEL `CreditInquiry`{`inquiry_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_system` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `event_time` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `purpose` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`inquiry_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Phone` (LABEL `Phone`{`phone_token` STRING NOT NULL, `normalization_scope` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`phone_token`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Account` (LABEL `Account`{`institution_id` STRING NOT NULL, `account_token` STRING NOT NULL, `account_namespace` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`institution_id`,`account_token`,`account_namespace`)}),
  EDGE TYPE `BORROWS` (`Borrower`)-[LABEL `BORROWS`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Loan`),
  EDGE TYPE `PROVIDES` (`Lender`)-[LABEL `PROVIDES`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Loan`),
  EDGE TYPE `APPLIES` (`Borrower`)-[LABEL `APPLIES`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`LoanApplication`),
  EDGE TYPE `SUBMITTED_TO` (`LoanApplication`)-[LABEL `SUBMITTED_TO`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Lender`),
  EDGE TYPE `HAS_FACILITY` (`Borrower`)-[LABEL `HAS_FACILITY`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`CreditFacility`),
  EDGE TYPE `GRANTS` (`Lender`)-[LABEL `GRANTS`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`CreditFacility`),
  EDGE TYPE `DRAWS_ON` (`Loan`)-[LABEL `DRAWS_ON`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`CreditFacility`),
  EDGE TYPE `HAS_DISBURSEMENT` (`Loan`)-[LABEL `HAS_DISBURSEMENT`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Disbursement`),
  EDGE TYPE `HAS_REPAYMENT` (`Loan`)-[LABEL `HAS_REPAYMENT`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Repayment`),
  EDGE TYPE `INQUIRY_SUBJECT` (`CreditInquiry`)-[LABEL `INQUIRY_SUBJECT`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Borrower`),
  EDGE TYPE `INQUIRY_BY` (`CreditInquiry`)-[LABEL `INQUIRY_BY`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Lender`),
  EDGE TYPE `USES_PHONE` (`Borrower`)-[LABEL `USES_PHONE`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Phone`),
  EDGE TYPE `USES_ACCOUNT` (`Borrower`)-[LABEL `USES_ACCOUNT`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Account`),
  EDGE TYPE `PAYS_TO` (`Disbursement`)-[LABEL `PAYS_TO`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Account`)
}

CREATE GRAPH TYPE IF NOT EXISTS `onto_verify_5602e6b6cefa_fraud_type` AS {
  NODE TYPE `Party` (LABEL `Party`{`party_id` STRING NOT NULL, `identity_evidence` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`party_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Account` (LABEL `Account`{`account_id` STRING NOT NULL, `institution_scope` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`account_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Transaction` (LABEL `Transaction`{`transaction_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `event_time` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `amount` DECIMAL(18, 2) NOT NULL, `currency` STRING NOT NULL, `status` STRING NOT NULL, `reverses_id` STRING DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`transaction_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `DeviceObservation` (LABEL `DeviceObservation`{`observation_id` STRING NOT NULL, `device_token` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `match_method` STRING NOT NULL, `confidence` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`observation_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `EvidenceRecord` (LABEL `EvidenceRecord`{`evidence_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_system` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `status` STRING NOT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `match_method` STRING NOT NULL, `confidence` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`evidence_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `InvestigationHypothesis` (LABEL `InvestigationHypothesis`{`hypothesis_id` STRING NOT NULL, `rule_id` STRING NOT NULL, `review_status` STRING NOT NULL, `counterevidence` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`hypothesis_id`)}),
  EDGE TYPE `OWNS_ACCOUNT` (`Party`)-[LABEL `OWNS_ACCOUNT`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Account`),
  EDGE TYPE `SENT_FROM` (`Transaction`)-[LABEL `SENT_FROM`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Account`),
  EDGE TYPE `RECEIVED_BY` (`Transaction`)-[LABEL `RECEIVED_BY`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Account`),
  EDGE TYPE `OBSERVED_FOR` (`DeviceObservation`)-[LABEL `OBSERVED_FOR`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Party`),
  EDGE TYPE `SUPPORTED_BY` (`InvestigationHypothesis`)-[LABEL `SUPPORTED_BY`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`EvidenceRecord`),
  EDGE TYPE `CONCERNS` (`InvestigationHypothesis`)-[LABEL `CONCERNS`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Party`),
  EDGE TYPE `DOCUMENTS_TRANSACTION` (`EvidenceRecord`)-[LABEL `DOCUMENTS_TRANSACTION`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`Transaction`),
  EDGE TYPE `DOCUMENTS_OBSERVATION` (`EvidenceRecord`)-[LABEL `DOCUMENTS_OBSERVATION`{`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY(`relation_id`)}]->(`DeviceObservation`)
}

label: historical_shared_phone
query:
MATCH (b1@Borrower)-[r1@USES_PHONE
  WHERE r1.valid_from <= $as_of AND (r1.valid_to IS NULL OR $as_of < r1.valid_to)]->(phone@Phone)
  <-[r2@USES_PHONE
  WHERE r2.valid_from <= $as_of AND (r2.valid_to IS NULL OR $as_of < r2.valid_to)]-(b2@Borrower)
WHERE b1.borrower_id < b2.borrower_id
RETURN b1.borrower_id AS first_borrower, b2.borrower_id AS second_borrower,
       phone.phone_token AS phone_token
